metadata.question: Within a 100 km radius of (-1.593993, -49.053062) in the Amazon Rainforest, on August 19, 2009, is there a greater presence of cloud cover over land areas compared to river areas?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point at (-1.593993, -49.053062) in the Amazon with 100 km radius buffer - Date: August 19, 2009 - Collection: Landsat 5 TM (available in 2009) - Need to identify land vs. river areas and compare cloud cover between them 2. Masking strategy: - Do NOT mask clouds - we need to MEASURE cloud cover - Classify pixels as: cloud, land, or water - Use thermal or optical bands to detect clouds (e.g., QA_PIXEL band or Band 1 reflectance) - For water detection: NDWI or MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) 3. Logic: - Extract QA_PIXEL band or use cloud probability - Calculate NDWI to separate water (rivers) from land - Measure cloud cover percentage in land areas vs. water areas - Compare: if land_cloud% > water_cloud%, answer is A; else B - Check for: empty collection (C1), no valid pixels (C2), invalid results (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry and time const center = ee.Geometry.Point([-1.593993, -49.053062]); const radius = 100 * 1000; // 100 km in meters const aoi = center.buffer(radius); const startDate = '2009-08-19'; const endDate = '2009-08-20'; // 2. Load Landsat 5 TM data const l5 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select(['SR_B1', 'SR_B2', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B4', 'SR_B5', 'SR_B7', 'QA_PIXEL']); const imgCount = l5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 5 Images Found: ${imgCount}`); if (imgCount === 0) { console.log('No images found for August 19, 2009 at this location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Use first available image const img = ee.Image(l5.first()); // 4. Cloud detection from QA_PIXEL band // Bit 3 = Cloud, Bit 4 = Cloud Shadow const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(8).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(16).eq(0)); // 0 = no cloud/shadow // 5. Calculate NDWI to separate water (rivers) from land const blue = img.select('SR_B1').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const nir = img.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const swir = img.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const ndwi = nir.subtract(swir).divide(nir.add(swir)); // Modified NDWI const water = ndwi.gt(0.3); // Water pixels const land = ndwi.lte(0.3); // Land pixels // 6. Cloud presence (invert cloudMask: 1 = cloud, 0 = clear) const cloud = cloudMask.not(); // 7. Calculate cloud cover over land areas const landCloud = cloud.updateMask(land); const landStats = landCloud.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: aoi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const landCloudPixels = ee.Number(landStats.get('QA_PIXEL_sum')).getInfo(); const landTotalPixels = ee.Number(landStats.get('QA_PIXEL_count')).getInfo(); const landCloudCover = landTotalPixels > 0 ? (landCloudPixels / landTotalPixels) * 100 : 0; // 8. Calculate cloud cover over water/river areas const waterCloud = cloud.updateMask(water); const waterStats = waterCloud.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: aoi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterCloudPixels = ee.Number(waterStats.get('QA_PIXEL_sum')).getInfo(); const waterTotalPixels = ee.Number(waterStats.get('QA_PIXEL_count')).getInfo(); const waterCloudCover = waterTotalPixels > 0 ? (waterCloudPixels / waterTotalPixels) * 100 : 0; console.log(`Land pixels: ${landTotalPixels}, Cloud pixels: ${landCloudPixels}, Cover: ${landCloudCover.toFixed(2)}%`); console.log(`Water pixels: ${waterTotalPixels}, Cloud pixels: ${waterCloudPixels}, Cover: ${waterCloudCover.toFixed(2)}%`); // 9. Validation if (landTotalPixels === 0 || waterTotalPixels === 0) { console.log('Insufficient pixels for land or water classification.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (isNaN(landCloudCover) || isNaN(waterCloudCover)) { console.log('Invalid cloud cover calculation.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 10. Compare cloud cover: is land cloud cover > water cloud cover? console.log(`Comparison: Land (${landCloudCover.toFixed(2)}%) vs Water (${waterCloudCover.toFixed(2)}%)`); if (landCloudCover > waterCloudCover) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
